#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <cstring>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

const int gigamod = 1000000007;
const double epsilon = 0.00000001;

int check(const string& tgt, const string& src) {
    int n = tgt.length();
    if (src.length() != n) return 0;

    char xDig = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (src[i] == 'X') {
            if (xDig == 0) {
                xDig = tgt[i];
            } else {
                if (tgt[i] != xDig) return 0;
            }
        }
    }

    if (tgt[0] == '0') return 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (src[i] != '_' && src[i] != 'X' && tgt[i] != src[i]) return 0;
    }

    return 1;
}

class FastReader {
private:
    istream& in;
    string buffer;
    size_t pos;

public:
    FastReader(istream& input) : in(input), pos(0) {}

    string next() {
        while (pos < buffer.size() && isspace(buffer[pos])) pos++;
        if (pos >= buffer.size()) {
            getline(in, buffer);
            pos = 0;
            while (pos < buffer.size() && isspace(buffer[pos])) pos++;
        }
        size_t start = pos;
        while (pos < buffer.size() && !isspace(buffer[pos])) pos++;
        return buffer.substr(start, pos - start);
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(next());
    }

    char nextChar() {
        return next()[0];
    }
};

    int t = 1;

            if (sOG[0] == '0' || sOG[0] == '_' || sOG[0] == 'X')
                cout << 1 << endl;
            else
                cout << 0 << endl;
            continue;
        }

        long long answer = 0;

        // 00 case
        {
            string s = sOG;
            bool invalid = (s[n - 1] != '_' && s[n - 1] != 'X' && s[n - 1] != '0');
            invalid |= (s[n - 2] != '_' && s[n - 2] != 'X' && s[n - 2] != '0');

            if (!invalid) {
                if (s[n - 1] == 'X' || s[n - 2] == 'X') {
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                        if (s[i] == 'X') s[i] = '0';
                    }
                }
                s[n - 1] = '0';
                s[n - 2] = '0';

                answer += check("00", s);

                for (int num = 0; num < 1000000; num++) {
                    string tgt = to_string(num) + "00";
                    answer += check(tgt, s);
                }
            }
        }

        // 25 case

            invalid |= (s[n - 2] != '_' && s[n - 2] != 'X' && s[n - 2] != '2');
            invalid |= (s[n - 1] == 'X' && s[n - 2] == 'X');

            if (!invalid) {

            invalid |= (s[n - 2] != '_' && s[n - 2] != 'X' && s[n - 2] != '5');
            invalid |= (s[n - 1] == 'X' && s[n - 2] == 'X');

            if (!invalid) {
